paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
notes: Paper sets new LEP limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (and g_aBB) in the MeV-90 GeV range from Z->2gamma and Z->3gamma decays, plus LHC/FCC-ee projections. The exclusion limits are presented only in log-log plots (Fig. 4) with no numerical table of (mass, coupling) limit points; Table 1 gives signal/background cross sections at a fixed coupling g=1e-4 GeV^-1, not exclusion contours. Therefore no reliable (mass_eV, coupling) limit pairs can be extracted. Coupling type is AxionPhoton (g_agamma), though paper also discusses hypercharge coupling g_aBB. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 4(a) shows ALP-photon (hypercharge) coupling limits in log10(g) vs log10(m_a) plane.
